intent: Plan a turf project in Boulder, CO: confirm which city landscape rules apply, the residential turf cap, functional-turf exceptions, and site conditions on the south Boulder mesas.
distinctValue: Boulder's 7 March 2026 water-wise landscape standards prohibit non-functional artificial turf in new development and cap turf at 25% of the lot or 1,000 square feet on home lots of three units or fewer; Flatirons Golf Course's playing area counts as functional turf; the south Boulder mesas carry Valmont and related soils, swelling clay over cobble with old terrace escarpments. Eldorado Springs, folded into this page, is unincorporated Boulder County: the city's turf rule doesn't reach it, its sewage district (not the city) governs what goes down the drain, and part of the canyon sits in the county's mapped floodplain along South Boulder Creek where some projects need an individual floodplain permit and others qualify under the county's General FDP.
